  MINUTES
  VERNON COMMUNITY FUND GRANT COMMITTEE
  REGULAR MEETING

  Frank Gaviña, Committee Member

  ABSENT:
  Sebastian Lozano, Committee Member

  STAFF PRESENT:
  Zayna Moussa-Milward, City Attorney
  Genoveva Rocha, City Clerk
  Diana Figueroa, Communications and Public Information Manager
  Alice Hui, Finance Director/City Treasurer
  Frances Jemmott, Consultant
  James Hull, Consultant

  PUBLIC COMMENT

  None.

  CONSENT CALENDAR

  MOTION
  Member Lopez moved and Vice Chair Froberg seconded a motion to approve the
  Consent Calendar. The question was called and the motion carried 4-0, Member
  Lozano absent

  The Consent Calendar consisted of the following item:

  1.  Meeting Minutes
  Recommendation: Approve the August 20, 2025 Special Vernon CommUNITY
  Fund Grant Committee Meeting Minutes.

  NEW BUSINESS

  2.  Fiscal Year 2025-26 Vernon CommUNITY Fund Direct Service Grants
  Recommendation:
  Award Fiscal Year 2025-26 Direct Service Grants totaling $180,000 to the following
  applicants:
  1) CA Derby Dolls - $5,000; 2) Chicxs Rockerxs - $28,000; 3) East Los Angeles
  Boys & Girls Club/East LA Rising - $5,000; 4) Holy Angels Church of the Deaf -
  $28,000; 5) Las Fotos Project - $28,000; 6) Latino Equality Alliance - $33,000; 7)
  Southeast Community Foundation – $33,000; 8) Southeast Rio Vista YMCA -
  $15,000; and 9) Toque Foundation - $5,000.

  Communications and Public Information Manager Figueroa presented the staff
  report.

  Consultant Fran Jemmott of the Jemmott Rollins Group provided additional
  information on the vetting process and due diligence on the grantee organizations.
  Since Toque Foundation was a new organization to the Vernon CommUNITY
  Fund, Consultant Jemmott provided details on the organization and the youth
  futsal sports league program it supports and explained the way the non-profit
  worked and operated separately from the for-profit part of the organization. She
  shared The Toque Foundation intends to utilize the grant to hire teenagers in the
  14-16 age group, who would otherwise not be employable, giving them the
  opportunity to earn an income and allow the organization to expand its ability to
  serve. She confirmed each of the grantee organizations do submit a required Final
  Report of Distribution related to the Direct Service Grant funding received through
  the Vernon CommUNITY Fund Grant Committee. It was clarified the report is not

  a formal audit but serves as a report of actual usage and a measure of
  accountability and assurance the grant monies were used appropriately.

  Chairperson Edry invited Committee questions and public comments. There being
  none, Chairperson Edry called for a motion.

  MOTION
  Member Gaviña moved and Member Lopez seconded a motion to award Fiscal
  Year 2025-26 Direct Service Grants totaling $180,000 to the following applicants:
  1) CA Derby Dolls - $5,000; 2) Chicxs Rockerxs - $28,000; 3) East Los Angeles
  Boys & Girls Club/East LA Rising - $5,000; 4) Holy Angels Church of the Deaf -
  $28,000; 5) Las Fotos Project - $28,000; 6) Latino Equality Alliance - $33,000; 7)
  Southeast Community Foundation – $33,000; 8) Southeast Rio Vista YMCA -
  $15,000; and 9) Toque Foundation - $5,000.

  The question was called and the motion carried 4-0, Member Lozano absent.

  ORAL REPORTS

  3.  Brief Reports, Announcements, or Directives to Staff

  Communications and Public Information Manager Figueroa announced
  recruitment efforts are on-going to fill two vacant seats on the Vernon CommUNITY
  Fund Grant Committee. She explained the application and more information can
  be found on the City’s website under Board Appointments. She also wished
  everyone a happy Thanksgiving and a great holiday season.

  ADJOURNMENT

  With no further business, Chairperson Edry adjourned the meeting at 10:26 a.m.
